agent_output:
Created ticket TCK-001: Incident summary: checkout API outage due to expired TLS certificate

Description:
Incident: On 2026-09-01, the checkout API was down for 47 minutes.
Root cause identified in incident notes: an expired TLS certificate.

Postmortem notes were requested but the file notes/postmortem.txt was not found, so this ticket is based on the available incident note only.

Impact:
- Checkout API unavailable for 47 minutes

Cause:
- Expired TLS certificate

Action item:
- Review certificate renewal/monitoring process to prevent recurrence.
